Who is Diplomat Management Services (DMS) Bahrain?

DMS is a Bahrain-based strategic consultancy with over 40 years of experience providing GRO, visa services, company formation, and corporate administration to enterprises and families.

What visa services does DMS offer?

We manage Bahrain visit visas, Golden Visas, Self-Sponsorship residence permits, Family Joining visas for KSA Iqama holders, Saudi visas (as an authorized Saudi Embassy agent), and global outbound visas.

Do you provide company formation and CR renewal services?

Yes. We manage end-to-end commercial registrations (CR), annual CR renewals, business activity amendments, commercial address updates, and equity ownership transfers with MOIC.

Does DMS handle mandatory annual compliance filings?

Yes, including Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) declarations, Economic Substance Requirements (ESR) filings, and corporate annual audit report submissions.

Is there a document collection and delivery service?

Yes. We provide safe, verified, and free pickup & delivery of confidential passports and corporate documentation directly across Bahrain.
